name: Academics
description: Knowledge of scholarly subjects: anthropology, archaeology, art, cultures, history, linguistics, philosophy, psychology, sociology, and esoteric topics like dimensional geography, magic, the occult, and mythical beings. A rank of 4d+ suggests highly educated or well-read.

name: Charm
description: Reflects attractiveness, empathy, social skills, and force of personality. Used to bluff, charm, deceive, negotiate, persuade, or seduce. Acting also falls under Charm.

name: Command
description: Getting others to do what you want through force of will. Used to command, frighten, intimidate, interrogate, motivate, or order people around. Also covers command structures and protocols.

name: Covert
description: Intrusion, larceny, shadowing, stealth, and surveillance. Used to hide, move quietly, follow someone, conduct surveillance, defeat security (alarms, cameras, locks, traps), palm items, and pick pockets. Note: Agility can substitute at half rank for Covert rolls to hide, move quietly, or avoid detection.

name: Investigation
description: Conducting investigations, uncovering clues, performing research, interrogating witnesses, analyzing data, and making deductive or intuitive leaps. A rank of 4d+ means investigations may be admissible in court.

name: Medicine
description: Academic and clinical knowledge of medicine and psychology. Can treat wounded characters with medical supplies: Hard (2) Medicine roll, heals 1 damage per net success. Treating yourself raises difficulty to Daunting (3). Once per patient per day (or once per week with Gritty Combat rules). A rank of 4d+ suggests a trained doctor.

name: Professional
description: Knowledge of the professional world: business, economics, finance, and basics of accounting, journalism, law, marketing, politics, public relations. The Expertise Power represents in-depth knowledge of a specific career.

name: Science
description: Scientific topics: astronomy, biology, botany, chemistry, ecology, genetics, geology, metallurgy, oceanography, physics, quantum mechanics, and esoteric/fantastical science. A rank of 4d+ suggests a trained scientist.

name: Streetwise
description: Knowledge of important locations, personalities, and happenings in the criminal underworld. Used to interact with criminals and navigate the underworld.

name: Survival
description: Surviving in the wild: building fires, finding food/water, securing shelter, setting traps, tracking. Also covers practical animal knowledge, handling animals, and riding mounts. A rank of 4d+ may allow caring for, taming, and training animals.

name: Technology
description: Creation, modification, and repair of mechanical and technological devices of all kinds (computers, electronics, machines, robots, vehicles, weapons). Also covers use of high-tech systems. Can repair damaged objects with proper tools: Hard (2) Technology roll, 1 point repaired per net success, once per object per day.

name: Vehicles
description: Operating all sorts of vehicles: piloting, gunnery, navigation, operations, and basic maintenance. Ordinary vehicles (cars, motorcycles) typically accessible at any rank; more exotic vehicles (helicopters, aircraft) at 4d+; experimental or advanced vehicles at 7d+. GM has final say.
